intro: Where AFTERHAUL is heading, from the first drivable truck to release. Each item shows its status. This is a draft plan: items can move, change or be dropped, and we set dates only when a stage is close.

stages.name: Concept
stages.lead: Planning and groundwork. Nothing is playable yet.

items.title: Game design written
items.text: The whole game, from the first haul to the last region, is on paper.

items.title: Core rules written and tested
items.text: Trucks, weather, hunger and thirst, clothing and truck parts all have working rules.

items.title: Website and player guide
items.text: You are looking at it. The guide grows with the game.

items.title: First drivable truck
items.text: One truck on a test field, with real weight, steering and engine behaviour.

items.title: First driver
items.text: A body that moves with its own muscles, falls and gets back up, and can be dressed.

stages.name: Alpha
stages.lead: The first playable version. Rough, small and for invited testers.

items.title: Small crews in one truck
items.text: A few players share a truck, with voice chat and a host who runs the session.

items.title: First region and first contracts
items.text: One region to cross, with cargo to haul, fuel to find, and damage to repair.

items.title: Real gameplay on this site
items.text: Footage from the game replaces the placeholder animations here.

items.title: Closed tests
items.text: Invited players on many kinds of computers, Linux included, report what breaks.

stages.name: Beta
stages.lead: Most of the game is in. More players try it and help shape it.

items.title: More regions
items.text: The rest of the land opens up, each with its own ground and weather.

items.title: Weather and seasons
items.text: Storms, snow and heat change how you drive and what you wear.

items.title: Driver classes
items.text: All eight classes, with their own skills and truck parts.

items.title: A living economy
items.text: Prices, jobs and rebuilding that change as the world recovers.

items.title: Full crews of eight
items.text: Eight players and eight trucks, tuned until it runs smoothly.

items.title: Beta on Steam
items.text: Open to more players, with fixes shipped as patches and listed in the changelog.

stages.name: Release
stages.lead: The finished first version, ready for everyone.

items.title: The full campaign
items.text: From the first delivery to the front line, polished.

items.title: Modding
items.text: Build a truck or a change and share it. A truck is one folder of files.

items.title: Later regions as free updates
items.text: More of the land arrives after release.
